newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Jan CPI rises 4.7 pct - government.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Jan CPI rises 4.7 pct - government.

text.p: South Korea's consumer price index (CPI) rose 4.7 percent in January on the year, up from a 5.1 percent rise a year earlier, Ministry of Finance and Economy figures showed on Thursday.
(Note: Base year is 1995 for 1997 figures and 1990 for the others)
Food prices rose year-on-year 3.6 percent in January,
The official said prices for vegetables rose 1.8 percent year-on-year in the month.
Prices for non-food products increased 5.3 percent.
The CPI, South Korea's leading inflation indicator, rose 4.5 percent in the whole of 1996, down from a 4.7 percent rise in 1995, the ministry said.
It said the CPI rise would be around 4.5 percent this year.
